book: X. Rui, G. Wang, J. Zhang, Transfer Matrix Method for Multibody Systems: Theory and Applications, Wiley 2019
quantity: relative rotation angles of pin hinges 0, 2, 4 (rad) vs t (s)
model_note: hinge axes not stated in the text; axes z (ground), y and z (body frames of the inboard bodies) reproduce the figure
read_method: Page rendered at 200 dpi (pdftoppm). Axis pixel positions from the tick marks. At each time t the dark pixel run of the plotted book curve nearest the expected value is read in a 3-pixel-wide column; low/high are the run edges widened by 1 px (axis calibration). Read points avoid steep slopes and sharp extrema. Read uncertainty: 2 px beyond low/high (rasterization 1 px, plot resolution of the book 1 px).
